ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a marine food web. The lower left corner is labeled “phytoplankton”, and near above it is labeled “Krill”. From the position of phytoplankton, there is an arrow directly leading to Krill, indicating that Krill directly obtains food or energy from phytoplankton. The image also shows higher-level organisms such as blue whales, penguins, seals, seabirds, killer whales, etc. Reasoning: The question asks if phytoplankton disappears, which part of the food web would be most directly affected. The most directly affected are the organisms that have a direct food relationship with phytoplankton. According to the direct arrow in the image, this organism is Krill.
